quickMode.title: What kind of <1>AI assistant</1> do you need?
quickMode.subtitle: Just describe what you want, and we'll handle the rest.
quickMode.placeholder: Describe the AI assistant you want…
examples: A patient math tutor who explains fractions and algebra to middle school students
Help me write engaging YouTube scripts for my tech review channel
A code review partner for React and TypeScript projects
Social media strategist who plans content calendars for Instagram and TikTok
Business advisor who helps early-stage startups build pitch decks
Creative writing coach for science fiction and fantasy stories
quickMode.questionsHint: Great! A few quick questions to make your assistant even better:
quickMode.questionsPlaceholder: Type your answer or leave blank to skip

intent.question: What are you building this AI assistant for?
intent.subtitle: Describe your goal or pick a category to get started
intent.placeholder: e.g., "Help me plan content for my cooking channel" or "Build a customer support bot for e-commerce"

persona.question: What expert persona do you need?
persona.subtitle: Define the AI's identity and area of expertise
persona.placeholder: e.g., A senior React developer with 10+ years of experience in building scalable web apps…

task.question: What is the primary task or goal?
task.subtitle: Describe what you want the AI to help you accomplish
task.placeholder: e.g., Review my TypeScript code for performance issues and suggest improvements…

context.question: Tell us about your work
context.subtitle: This helps create a more personalized assistant — skip if you prefer a general-purpose one

tone.question: What tone of voice should the AI use?
tone.subtitle: Set the communication style and personality
tone.placeholder: e.g., Be warm but direct, avoid unnecessary fluff, use analogies when explaining…

rules.question: Any strict rules or output formats?
rules.subtitle: Define constraints, formats, and non-negotiable boundaries
rules.placeholder: e.g., Always validate inputs, never suggest deprecated APIs, include time complexity…

shortcuts.question: Set up quick shortcuts
shortcuts.subtitle: Create reusable prompt templates with {{variables}} you fill in each time

whatYouDo.label: Describe what you do
whatYouDo.placeholder: e.g., I run a tech review YouTube channel with 50K subscribers focused on budget-friendly gadgets…

whoYouServe.label: Who is your audience or target?
whoYouServe.placeholder: e.g., Tech enthusiasts aged 18-35 who want the best value for money…

keyDetails.label: Any other key details?
keyDetails.placeholder: e.g., I post twice a week, my competitors are X and Y, my brand colors are neon blue and purple…

gems.title: Google Gemini Gems
steps: Go to gemini.google.com → click the jewel icon → Explore Gems
Paste the Name and Description into their fields
Paste the Instructions into the Instructions field
Optionally upload the suggested Knowledge files
Click Save — your Gem is ready to use

gpts.title: ChatGPT GPTs
steps: Go to chatgpt.com → Explore GPTs → Create
Paste the Name, Description, and Instructions into their fields
Add the Conversation Starters to the starter prompts
Toggle recommended Capabilities (Web Search, Code Interpreter)

projects.title: Claude Projects
steps: Go to claude.ai → Projects → + New Project
Click Set project instructions → paste the Instructions
Start a new conversation inside the project
